Name: Wondurdog Deluxe Indoor Dog & Cat Washing Shower Kit
Description: Give your best buddy a groomer-quality bath in the comfort of your home with a Wondurdog Deluxe Indoor Dog & Cat Washing Shower Kit. This unique kit is designed to help you give your fur-iend a bath indoors without the mess. The special splash shield shower brush head keeps the water where you need it—away from your buddy's ears and eyes. Water pressure control lets you increase or decrease water pressure with a slide of the valve, which means a deeper and easier clean. The brush’s rubber teeth make it paw-fect for brushing and massaging both long, and short-haired fur-iends. Finally, the kit includes an 8-foot stainless-steel hose that can be stored on the suction cup holder or on a shower diverter, with a hook for the shower brush head. It’ll feel like a day at the spaw, in your own bathroom!
